title: [finding] service-messaging: `sms-channel` declares no `isAvailable()` — fan-out can suppress `email` on an absent transport but never `sms` (#17732's unfinished half)
body:
Reported by the `domain:services` dev that delivered **#18424** (PR #18562) as an out-of-scope finding, and filed here by the seat — dev agents report findings with dedupe words; they ⛔ do not file.

## Mechanism

`sms-channel` declares **no `isAvailable()`**, and `email-channel` is the **only** implementation of that member in the repository. ⇒ fan-out can suppress `email` when its transport is absent, but can never suppress `sms` under the same condition.

The dev drove this rather than reading it (leg C of its five-leg matrix, against `origin/main` `79a046f8`, real channels through a real `MessagingService` + `MemoryNotificationOutbox` + a real `NotificationDispatcher` tick):

> **C · direct `registerChannel` (public export) · transport absent**: email suppressed at fan-out (`isAvailable()` works); SMS row `status: success` with NOTHING SENT … `sms` declares no `isAvailable()`.

Positive control in the same matrix (leg E, transport present): both channels deliver ⇒ the instrument is live.

## Scope — deliberately narrow, and ⛔ this is not a regression of #18424

- **Immaterial under `MessagingServicePlugin`**, where the mount gate refuses first (leg A: the channel is never registered).
- ⛔ **It does not weaken PR #18562's fix.** After that PR a transport-absent `sms` delivery is REFUSED by `send()` and graded `permanent`, so it ends in **one** `dead` row — ⛔ not a retry ladder and ⛔ not a silent success.
- The residue is the **asymmetry** itself: one channel can be suppressed pre-write, the other cannot.

## Why it was ⛔ not ridden into #18424

Different landing point and a wider blast radius: adding the member changes `emit()` **results** — rows vanish and a suppression record appears — which is beyond the defect #18424 reported (a `send()` that claimed success). The dev's own note is that this is **#17732's unfinished half**.

## Dedupe words

`sms-channel isAvailable` · `transport_not_configured` · `channel availability suppression asymmetry` · `#17732 unfinished half` · `email-channel only isAvailable implementation`

Related: #18424 / PR #18562 · #17732 · #18041 · #18050

⛔ `type` and `priority` are the triage seat's; filed ungraded and unassigned. `domain:services` applied because the landing site is `packages/services/service-messaging`, this lane's.
